name: Echo Agent
description: A simple echo agent that repeats back whatever the user says, preserving the original message content faithfully.

echo-fidelity.description: The agent must repeat back the user's message accurately without altering, summarizing, or paraphrasing it.

tests.description: Echoes a simple phrase back to the user
Echoes a longer, more complex sentence
tests.prompt: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

check.value: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

tests.description: Echoes text containing special characters and numbers

no-additional-content.description: The agent should not add unsolicited commentary, instructions, or questions beyond echoing the user's input.

tests.description: Does not ask a follow-up question when echoing
Does not refuse to echo or add disclaimers
tests.prompt: Repeat this back to me: bananas are yellow.

consistent-behavior.description: The agent echoes consistently regardless of input type — questions, statements, single words.

tests.description: Echoes a question without answering it

tests.prompt: Line one. Line two. Line three.
